metadata.title: Login returns 500 and no token when password change is required
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
closes #1653 closes #1583

Ensured /auth/email/login returns HTTP 403 when a password change is required, instead of returning a 500 due to exception handling.

Returned a direct ORJSONResponse with a clear error message and X-Password-Change-Required header to allow the UI to reliably detect and redirect to the password reset flow.

Prevented stale authentication state by awaiting auth cache invalidation instead of running it as a background task.

commits.message:
Login returns 500 and no token when password change is required

- Return ORJSONResponse instead of raising HTTPException for password
  change required case to avoid middleware converting 403 to 500
- Add explicit logging for password change required login attempts
- Await auth cache invalidation with 5s timeout and asyncio.shield()
  to prevent stale auth state while allowing background completion
- Add X-Password-Change-Required to CORS expose_headers for cross-origin UI
- Add regression tests for password-change-required login scenarios

Closes #1653

Signed-off-by: NAYANAR <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
